dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
I... doubt you're telling me to shush.
引荐……应该不是这个意思吧。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
Haven't I told you that your contractions are causing communication difficulties?
我早就说了，像那样省略的话交流起来会产生误会的。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
Haah... I meant to say "Secret Handover, Here".
哈啊……有隐藏的竹简。

The child sighed deeply, frustrated at the other's lack of comprehension, and tossed a small piece of dried bamboo scroll at them.
孩子像是觉得说不通似的叹了口气，将手中的小木板随手抛给了站在后面的另一个人。

There was something scrawled on the scroll with a brush.
那块像是用晾干的竹片压平后做成的木板上写着潦草的毛笔字。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
Our next assignment, I see.
是下一项指示。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
Summarize it for me. Though I doubt it's anything more than another mindless slaughter.
你自己概括一下吧。反正肯定又是毫无趣味的普通杀戮。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
... What's that?
……那是什么？

Perhaps the child's behavior was already infamous among them.
也许孩子的这种作风早就在黑兽中传开了。

The other beast of this Heishou Pack has never met this child before, but they don't seem at all surprised by this child's apparent extra-mission obsession with finding entertainment in assassinations.
那个黑兽今天才第一次见到孩子，却对孩子这番无视指示、从杀死目标中寻求乐趣的话语毫无质疑之意。

In fact, they appear rather fascinated as the child continues to draw something in her own bamboo scroll.
反而觉得孩子单手持着木板写着什么的样子更有趣。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
Hmph, none of your business.
呵。你没必要知道。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

dataList.content:
The Heishou goes back to reading the mission scroll without question. A silent accord.
似乎是觉得说得在理，那黑兽立刻打消了念头，开始仔细查看孩子抛来的东西。

While the other one reads and summarizes the mission scroll, let's see what this child is writing.
在那人总结要点时……来看看孩子在写些什么吧。

[How unbelievably dull. It is somehow more entertaining to write a record about myself.]
[怎么这么无聊啊。还不如写些关于自己的记录作乐更有意思。]

[No one will be reading this art, but one day, perhaps my future self shall read it to look back and reminisce.]
[虽然无法成为谁都能读懂的艺术作品，不过也许未来某天，我自己能够将其细细品味与回忆吧。]

[Hm... let's describe the stage.]
[嗯……首先是背景描写。]

[I am surrounded by a mountain of bodies, everything around me marred and gory, scarred by cuts, drowned in guts.]
[我于尸山中漫步，不见活物。刀痕遍布，血流漂杵。]

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
Heh... that rhymes.
哼……押韵了。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
What?
你说什么？

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
Nothing.
没什么。

[I should make a record of this before my memories grow faint.]
[在此刻的记忆模糊之前，记录下这一切会更好。]

[Yes. Suddenly, one moment... I had become a beast.]
[是的。不知何时……我成为了野兽。]

[I'm certain there were moments lost to the fog that could have become radiant masterpieces, yet all have been burned away—to my chagrin.]
[肯定时不时有过亮眼作品般的瞬间，却不知道都挥发到哪去了，真令人心烦不已。]

[... I have memories of having served a lord, once... yet it was not like this. Maybe.]
[……虽然似乎有过侍奉主公的记忆，但和现在的感觉却不一样。]

[I don't care for my current lord, anyway... Well, like always, the only change is the hand that holds the leash.]
[我对现在的主公没什么兴趣……嘛，反正只是拉着我的辔头的手又换了一双罢了。]

[Only follow the tug of the leash, and cut down whomever, whatever lies in that path.]
[口中衔着的辔头几经转手，我只是被牵着移动，将挡路的东西尽数砍倒或斩断。]

[That was today... and, well. That mission scroll won't have anything new.]
[今天也是这样……那片竹简上写的内容，大概也没什么不同吧。]

[My only joy scavenged from the ephemeral moments of blossom, no more.]
[唯有在那瞬间绽放的刹那之美中寻得的欢愉，方可称之为乐吗。]

[Ah, yes. I remember testing my strength against a different beast of the Heishou as well.]
[啊，对了。前不久我与别的黑兽交手了。]

[There are eleven more branches to Heishou Packs other than us hares, after all...]
[毕竟除了我们兔子以外，黑兽还有其他十一支……]

[Perhaps my present lord was in a conflict with another. Not that I'm complaining. I'd love for the lord to keep making new enemies like a little bitch.]
[恐怕现在的主公正在和其他主公发生冲突。这是件好事。我喜欢主公像小孩一样到处惹是生非。]

[At least that will bring me a scintilla of joy.]
[至少那样我还能获得片刻欢愉。]

[I wonder—what if my current lord feuds with my former lord...? Hm. It would make for a tired old cliché, but experiencing it firsthand could also—]
[假如发生冲突的对象是我曾经的主公……嗯。虽然是种老土的剧情，但如果能实际遇上一次的话……]

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
Hey.
喂。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
... You're intent on ruining my fun tonight.
……你给我今晚的享受泼了盆冷水呢。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
This better be important.
如果是用微不足道的话语，让我停笔……

The child glared at the other beast as though she was ready to stab them with her brush, but...
孩子似乎相当生气，像是要将其刺穿一般紧紧握着笔，瞪着另一只黑兽……

... they only returned her a cold glare, wagging the mission scroll in her face.
但那人只是若无其事地回以冰冷的眼神，把玩着手中的木板。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
Time to hop on to our next job, that's all.
只是到该尽情蹦跳的时间了。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
Tch.
啧。

The child wished to record a scene of her fights, perhaps.
孩子也许是，也想记录下自己战斗的样子吧。

As beasts of the Heishou Pack have no need for unnecessary recollections, the memories can wither away at any moment.
无用的记忆对黑兽来说是不需要的，因为这些记忆随时都有风化的可能。

But having the time to write anything at all was a luxury these missions could not provide.
但在紧急任务的现场，也不可能悠然地在木板上写什么字吧。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Beasts of the Heishou Pack are here! They sent the M-Mao branch?!
是黑兽！卯、他们送来了卯！

... But maybe we can get a first-hand account this time.
……既然如此，这次我们亲自去看看应该比较好呢。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

dataList.content:
Her eyes widen slightly, becoming oval-shaped.
孩子的眼睛似乎捕捉到了什么有趣的东西，瞬间睁得圆圆的。

Then her lips curl upward, noticing something that caught her interest.
随后她好像觉得很有意思一般，微微翘起了嘴角。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
You're wearing a nice fabric.
衣服看着不错。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
Have I seen it somewhere before?
我好像在哪里见过呢。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Ahh, ahhh!
噫、噫呀！

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Wait, y-you're...!
你、你是……

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
Me? I'm Ryō—
我？我是良……

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
Get your shit together.
发什么呆呢。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
We're hares.
我们是兔子。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
We don't ask each other questions.
我们不会互相问问题。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
We do not know where we each reside.
也不知道对方的落脚之处。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
But once called to a mission, we gather and become a husk of hares.
但是一旦指示规定的时间到来，我们就必会聚集成群。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
Together, we complete the mission, and scatter once again.
聚集，执行指示，然后散去。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Dammit... if only I still had Heishou Packs of my own...!
妈的……如果我没有失去黑兽的全部所有权就好了……

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
I shouldn't have made that stupid bet... I shouldn't have wagered my own beasts... The Mao branch was mine...!
我居然参与了那样荒唐的赌局，连自己的黑兽都赌上了……本来卯是……！

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
... Aha.
……啊哈。

The child lets out a brief cry of what sounded like joy, realizing what it was that has been tickling her mind this whole time.
孩子好像终于明白了自己之前觉得有趣的是什么一般，发出了一声短暂的轻笑。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
I remember now, from a passing memory... So maybe this one's one of my past lords.
好像有点印象了……也有那样的主公啊。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
This cliché is playing it a bit too safe.
还真是老套啊……这种情节。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
W-wait! You... we... if we know each other...!
等、等下！难道你……你认识我……！

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
Haah... no, she doesn't.
哈……不。她不认识。

The target crawled towards the child, about to plead at her feet, but the other beast stepped in.
哭泣的目标抓住孩子的裤腿，想要拖住她，但和孩子一起来的人叹了口气，将其拦住了。

They knew that this child wasn't stupid enough to jeopardize this mission, but... a Heishou has a line they mustn't cross.
那人知道孩子不至于愚蠢到把事情搞砸……但是黑兽也有自己要守住的底线。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
We don't need to know, nor should we know, who you are.
既不用认识，也不该认识。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
We are but beasts, our fur black as midnight.
我们只是黑色的野兽。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
We do not remember the faces of those who must be forgotten.
我们不会记得必须忘记之人的面容。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
Ahh... yes, of course.
啊啊……对，没错。是这样。

Surprisingly, the child does not appear to be upset by this sudden interjection.
在享受乐趣时出现如此插曲，孩子非但没有生气，反而意外地冷静。

In fact, she appears... rather content by this turn of events.
不如说……她似乎对事情的发展十分满意。

... Yes. So that's what it's been building up to.
……没错，就是这么一回事。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
We splatter, before we scatter.
我们挥洒，然后散去。

She could see it already, this clichéd scene rising to its climax with a one-liner for her to finish off this scene.
她只是在为这老套情节的结束准备一句台词。

dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯
dataList.content:
... Never should've trusted a beast that is black of fur, right?
只是……黑毛之兽不可信。不是吗？

... And that is why she laughs with such joy.
……而这就是她笑得如此开心的原因。
